reason: The exact v2025.11.01 Home 10 module table specifies 26.5 kg. The newer grouped manual identifies a different document revision.
In the ordered columns, 133.5 kg belongs to 4S. The requested 5S stack is the middle column at 160.0 kg.
Both excerpts describe single modules. Neither provides the net mass of the requested 4S system.
The matching revision expressly labels 49.1 Ah as usable capacity. It supplies no independently stated rated electrical Ah.
The middle 5S column gives the stack's rated output as 224 V. The 230 V figure instead powers an external AC EMS box.
The only source describes the EMS box's external AC power supply. It contains no evidence about the 5S stack's DC nominal voltage.
Only the 2025.11.01 module revision is supplied. The claim requests 2026.07.01, and the excerpt supplies no bridging revision evidence.
The exact 2026.07.01 HTML revision and its battery module table give 26.5 kg. The other excerpts apply to different revisions.
The UK version 15.0 manual includes the explicit V2 model and gives nominal electrical capacity as 50 Ah in both columns. The Australian V3 excerpt addresses a different variant.
The exact HV11550 V2 appears in the second column. The corresponding weight is 68.5 kg, while 72.2 kg belongs to the first column.
The exact Australian V3 source reports energy in kWh and current in A. The UK V2 manual's 50 Ah cannot establish rated electrical capacity for the Australian V3.

The AU V3 excerpt separates an integrated BMS+PACK assembly from the HV11550-A V3 module. Neither is documented as the requested T-BAT H 5.8 V3 module configuration. The UK manual describes earlier variants.
The Australian V3 battery's named nominal rating is 115.2 V. The 130 V value is the upper end of its operating range. The older UK table is inapplicable.
The applicable model's electrical ratings in the source are in Vdc. No value at the requested AC boundary is supplied.
The only excerpt is the Australian V3 data sheet, which does not identify rated Ah for the requested UK V2.
The quoted 61.5 kg explicitly belongs to BMS+PACK. The document names the bare module as HV11550-A V3 and gives it a different mass. The supplied packet cannot bind 61.5 kg to the requested module.
